item.title: Lady Gaga, Prince, Queen & More: Who Has the Best Billboard Hot 100 No. 2 Hit of All Time? Vote!
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the world of music and explore the stories behind the charts. Today, we're talking about the songs that almost made it to the top - the ones that peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100.
[Short music transition]
Host: Billboard recently rounded up their staff picks for the 100 best songs to reach No. 2 on the Hot 100, and we're excited to share some of those with you. From classic hits like Queen's "Bohemian Rhapsody" and Prince's "Purple Rain", to modern chart-toppers like Lady Gaga's "Bad Romance" and Missy Elliott's "Work It", the list spans decades and genres.
[Short music clip from one of the mentioned songs]
Host: These songs may not have reached the very top of the chart, but they've become defining moments for their artists and have endured for generations. In fact, Billboard has explored the phenomenon of No. 2 hits from several angles, including how some artists scored big without even being directly involved in the song.
[Short music transition]
Host: Now, we want to hear from you - which No. 2 hit is your favorite? You can check out Billboard's full list and vote in their poll to make your voice heard. Whether it's one of the top 10 standout hits or a hidden gem that deserves more love, we want to know what you think.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to this episode of our podcast. Join the conversation and let us know - what's the best No. 2 hit of all time?
